description: Kirklees Council is a metropolitan borough in West Yorkshire. Monthly workbooks Apr 2017 onward with Companies House numbers on supplier rows. Council redacts personal-data payments (adoption, fostering, care) at source. Default is procurement_paid.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions for direct payments to individuals (foster carers, ASC direct payments). Lawfully unnamed.
NHS Integrated Care Board rows are statutory health funding pass-through, not council procurement.
LGPS employer contributions to the West Yorkshire Pension Fund are internal pension flows, not procurement.

Kirklees Neighbourhood Housing was the council's wholly-owned ALMO (housing management returned in-house 2021); payments to it are council-to-own-arm flows, not third-party procurement. (Corona Energy (KNH) rows stay procurement_paid: third-party energy billed for KNH stock.)
